author_or_org: Markus Ilves, Eduard Barbu, Jaan Übi (University of Tartu)

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: The paper presents a schema-constrained evaluation framework that combines an explicit ontology of six entity types and 96 relation types with schema-injected prompts.
claims.quote: We present a schema-constrained evaluation framework that combines an explicit ontology of six entity types and 96 relation types with structured generation guided by schema-injected prompts.

claims.question: q5
claims.claim: LLMs capable of zero-shot and few-shot structured generation can directly generate typed entities and relations from raw text instead of training task-specific extraction models.
claims.quote: The emergence of large language models (LLMs) capable of zero-shot and few-shot structured generation has introduced a different paradigm for KG construction. Instead of training task-specific extraction models, LLMs can directly generate typed entities and relations from raw text.
